origin: Generalized from the Frontier Weave supervised harness hybrid (frontier-routing/v1).

supervised_hybrid.description: A frontier Claude or Codex coordinator session plans, freezes a task packet, dispatches one disposable OpenCode worker loop, runs cold deterministic gates, and reviews the captured diff. The worker holds no Git, sprintctl, deployment, or acceptance authority.

frontier_only.description: The coordinator harness owns planning, implementation, verification, and review without a bulk worker.

authority: edit files inside writable_patch_paths within its own worktree

coordinator_plan.purpose: Architecture, ambiguity resolution, dependency ordering, and packet construction.

coordinator_review.purpose: Wave review, failure classification, and corrected retry packets.

bulk.purpose: Routine bounded implementation, fixtures, schemas, mechanical migrations, and test-driven repair behind strong deterministic gates.

substantial.purpose: Multi-file implementation once contracts and architecture are already decided.

escalation.purpose: One corrected retry after coordinator triage of a failed packet.

worker_review_challenger.purpose: Read-only cheap challenger over the captured diff. Never substitutes for the required coordinator review.

required_before_dispatch: packet references an existing sprintctl item in a startable state
the coordinator holds the sprintctl claim for that item
architecture, acceptance criteria, and non-goals are settled
writable_patch_paths are inside the repository manifest scope.allowed_path_roots
no writable path intersects the repository hybrid.protected_paths
every registered command runs green cold in the disposable worktree before inference
the exact repository payload and worker model are operator-approved
route_to_coordinator_instead: security, credential, authority, or migration semantics
changes smaller than the packet overhead
a packet that already failed its escalation attempt

qualification.admission: Vuoro ecosystem tooling is admitted for real bounded implementation work. Every packet still requires a live coordinator claim, frozen acceptance contract, cold registered gates, captured artifact/session evidence, independent review, and human acceptance. Worker authority remains bounded by each repository manifest.
